subject: Startups
title: Calendly's Meeting Signature
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Calendly's Meeting Signature.

hook.text: Every Calendly link you click is an ad. 'Pick a time on my Calendly' is a growth hack disguised as convenience.

buildup.text: When someone sends a Calendly link, the recipient is exposed to the product. Most try it themselves within a week.

discovery.text: Calendly's viral loop is inherent in its function. You can't use it without showing it to someone else.

twist.text: The company barely marketed. Users did the spreading naturally. Each meeting scheduled was a product demo.

climax.text: Calendly hit $350 million ARR with a tiny marketing team. The product's utility was the entire go-to-market.

punchline.text: The link is the pitch. The calendar is the close.

quiz.question: Why is Calendly's growth model considered inherently viral?
options: It has a referral bonus program
Using it requires sharing it with others
